name: Sochi-Sukhumi Subsea Gas Pipeline (Russia-Abkhazia)
monitor_reason: length (no sourced length; unsourced, cannot confirm >=25 km) and concrete step (no sponsor commitment, no MOU/FEED/permit/tender/FID; only an Abkhaz politician's statement that the project would need Russian funding)
researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row: P0743 (Dzhubga-Lazarevskoye-Sochi) and P1475 (Maykop-Samur-Sochi) are Russia-internal; P0744 is Dzuarikau-Tskhinvali (South Ossetia); P4235 Kutaisi-Sukhumi is Georgia-internal. Evidence: livekuban.ru 2025-02-06 (Badra Gunba, Abkhaz politician/presidential candidate, interview) and sochistream.ru 2025-02-06 (same interview, same single origin, so not independent) say a Sochi-Sukhumi subsea branch from the Tuapse-Adler line is conceivable at ~90 bn rubles, Gazprom 'took part in developing' the project, Abkhazia lacks the money and depends on Russian support. Length not stated anywhere. tatar-inform.ru 2008-06-24 (Vedomosti citing then-President Bagapsh, Gazprom spokesman confirmed participation) shows the same idea floated in 2008 with no follow-through, outside the ~3-year window and indicating a recurring aspiration rather than a progressing project. Fails leg (a) (sponsor not identified as a committed developer; Gazprom participation is a background remark), leg (c) (no concrete step) and leg (d) (no sourced length). Values above are indicative only if later promoted; Status proposed, Abkhazia mapped to Georgia per naming conventions. Re-check if Gazprom/Russian government announces a feasibility study, intergovernmental agreement or funding.
